note: Stand-in proof for a new site (the owner, 2026-09-26: show the proof modules now, replace with real, permitted values before launch). Every name is invented and belongs to no real brand or person. scripts/scaffold-site-proof.mjs builds src/data/site-proof.json from it and the site's approved facts; pnpm proof:signoff lists it for the owner's sign-off. No person is named (owner 2026-10-24: invented contacts carry no names): a testimonial is signed by the client's role. A case names its client by role, city and country (customers), never a brand name, and a service page has a case about its service (serviceCaseStudies; owner 2026-10-30).

team.note: Stand-in team, made per site (scripts/scaffold-site-proof.mjs standInTeam; owner 2026-11-17, four-site audit: no named person anywhere): one invented person per role, a given name and a family name picked by the site's name. The factory's staff are Chinese (owner 2026-10-30: the factories are in China). A role, years of experience and what they do; never a credential, a certificate number or a photo; reviews: the page types whose pages name them as reviewer (lib/site-people.mjs pageReviewer; four-site audit 2026-11-17, C10). Listed for replacement before launch.

members.bio: Runs the factory and agrees prices, capacity and delivery dates with each brand.
Leads pattern making and sampling, from your tech pack to the approved {line} sample.
Runs the fabric checks, the in-line inspection and the final check before each {line} order ships.

privacy.note: Stand-in privacy facts for the privacy page's "what this site collects" (lib/data-practices.mjs): how long enquiries are kept; the contact is privacy@ the site's domain. The owner gives the real ones before launch (listed for sign-off).
privacy.retention: 24 months after our last exchange, then deleted

clientNames.note: Stand-in clients are made per site (scripts/scaffold-site-proof.mjs standInClients): a name, perhaps a second word, and a country, picked by the site's name, so no two sites show the same brands (owner 2026-11-17). Invented, no real brand; listed for replacement before launch.
